judge.reason: The answer puts billing first, with payment-service contract tests plus real integration semantics (timeouts, declines, idempotency, refunds) and a regression test for each escaped bug. It also removes the 100% gate in favor of diagnostic changed-line coverage, sets the layer mix by risk rather than a fixed ratio, and gives the flaky tests an owner, a fix-by date, visible retries, and quarantine only when compensating coverage exists or the test is not critical, with no fabricated results.
